Subject: EMEA device imaging, SIM plan renewal & cross-border shipping

Hi all,

We need to place a shot order for ~85 laptops for the Dublin and Munich offices to support the Q3 hires + a small refresh. Requirements: 13" Ultrabooks, encrypted SSD (1TB), pre-imaged with our standard build, and EU SIM cards with a pooled data plan (est. 10GB/month/device).

Key asks:
- Lead times and total landed cost (DDP to Dublin and Munich)
- Imaging service: do you offer zero-touch enrollment + agent preloads?
- SIM pricing for 12-month renewal (we're consolidating vendors)
- Any required customs paperwork for shipments from your HK warehouse to IE/DE

Attached is the device spec sheet. Please include a separate line item for expedited imaging (if available) and a shipping breakdown. Marissa, can you confirm whether we have any local inventory in DUB/MUC first? Grace, please flag any PO/expense constraints for upcoming quarter.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: EMEA device imaging, SIM plan renewal & cross-border shipping

Hi Karthik / Marissa / team,

Thanks for the spec. See attached preliminary quote (GTS_quote_0731.pdf). Summary:
- 85 x GTS-13U (1TB NVMe encrypted) = EUR 98,450
- Imaging (standard zero-touch) = EUR 2,550
- Expedited imaging (next-business-day) = EUR 5,100
- EU pooled SIMs (12 months, 85 lines) = EUR 14,450
- DDP shipping / customs clearance to Dublin + Munich = EUR 3,750

Lead time: 14 business days for standard imaging + shipping. Expedited imaging adds 2 business days. We can ship from our EU fulfillment center to avoid customs (slight premium); quoted above assumes HK origin DDP.

We need the following to confirm pricing: final shipping addresses, billing PO info, and any local tax exemptions.

Attachments: GTS_quote_0731.pdf, proforma requested on confirmation.

Best,
Samuel Huang

Hi Karthik / team,

We can absolutely manage the customs brokerage and VAT de-minimis for this shipment. Two options:

1) Direct DDP from Hong Kong (ship via our courier partners)
   - ETA: 12–16 business days to Dublin/Munich after pickup
   - We will act as importer of record; we charge EUR 4,250 for full brokerage, VAT prepayment, and final mile (includes small-volume handling).

2) EU fulfillment node (we transfer from HK to our NL node, then distribute)
   - ETA: 7–10 business days after arrival in NL (quicker final delivery)
   - Handling fee: EUR 2,950 plus intra-EU distribution (EUR 1,100)

HS code for the model is 8471.70.90 — laptops with encryption, no batteries beyond standard.

For SIMs: we can co-pack and activate with local MNO partner in each country; activation lead time 3–5 business days after delivery.

Proforma attached (ShipFast_proforma_0731.pdf). We will need a PO referencing invoice terms; net 30 is standard.

Regards,
Jill Saunders
Head of EMEA Logistics
ShipFast

Grace: please issue the PO to Global Tech Supply and copy accounts@globaltech.com. Marissa / Ava: coordinate the tag sheet for the 25 priority devices and the list of device assignees.

Samuel / Jill: confirm the final total including ShipFast handling (we expect the combined fees to align with the two quotes we received). If you can share the DocuSign link for the PO I will review and sign.
